question: Where does Green Room get hosted, and on what name?
context: PWA scaffold is built and verified in /mnt/user-data/outputs/green-room/. Three options were laid out to Anthony with explicit tradeoffs: (1) Netlify Drop for tonight, no account, ~60 seconds to live link, random URL; (2) Cloudflare Pages on a thetempleoftwo.com subdomain like greenroom.thetempleoftwo.com — durable, on his own infra, he already has Cloudflare connected; (3) GitHub Pages. I offered to walk the Cloudflare Pages deploy step by step. Anthony has not yet responded with a choice. The decision shapes the canonical share-link, whether the link is permanent or temporary, and whether Green Room lives on his own domain (which matters for the Temple of Two brand surface).
